name: wayne-code-review-flow
description: Formal static gate over one frozen diff: freeze (tracked + untracked) -> two independent voices (Claude + GPT) in parallel on shared criteria -> attributed synthesis -> PASS/FAIL. Portable across repos.

base.description: git ref or range to review (e.g. dev, main, HEAD~1...HEAD). Empty = uncommitted vs HEAD, falling back to last commit.
